name: One More Thing
description: From memory, everyone lists what they remember from the lesson, then the list passes to two classmates who each add one thing it missed. Your own list comes back grown, and the AI builds the class's collective memory.

intro.message:
ONE MORE THING

From memory, no notes! You'll list what you remember from today's lesson. Then your list travels: two classmates will each add one thing you missed.

It comes back to you, grown.

recall.prompt: From memory (no notes!): list the 2-3 most important things you remember from today's lesson. Put each on its own line.

add-one.prompt:
A classmate's list is above, their lines are locked in. ADD one thing they missed: a detail, a missing point, or a connection between ideas.

(List looking empty or thin? Start it yourself, write the biggest thing YOU remember.)

add-again.prompt: A different classmate's list, already grown once. Read the whole thing, then ADD one more thing it's still missing.

returned.hostTemplate:
Everyone's list just came back to its owner, grown by two classmates.

Give the room a quiet minute to read before continuing.

cluster.instruction: These are memory lists about today's lesson, each grown by three different students. Combine them into ONE master list of what the class collectively remembered: most-mentioned ideas first, grouped by theme, duplicates merged. End by naming one or two things that only a single list caught, credit the catch, not the student.

end.message: That's One More Thing, nobody's list came back the same size it left. Edit the prompts to run it on any lesson.
